set_aside.subject: implicit manual budget creation during archived-project progress read
set_aside.text: a staff read of a project's progress list, when the project has no manual budget version yet, creates that empty manual budget version
set_aside.question: Is the implicitly created empty manual budget version active, inactive, or otherwise excluded from the project's client-facing budget, especially when another budget version is already active?
options: Create it inactive and preserve the currently active budget version
Create and activate it when no budget version is active
Create and activate it even when another budget version is active
set_aside.default_guess: Create it inactive and do not change the active budget version.

witness.initial: An archived project has an active imported snapshot and no manual budget version.
events: An assigned staff member reads the project's progress list.
The portal creates the empty manual budget version required by R0-24.
A viewer subsequently reads the project's budget.
outcomes: The imported snapshot remains active and visible; the empty manual version has no client-facing effect.
The new empty manual version becomes active, replacing the imported budget with an empty or unavailable budget.
witness.observer: The viewer and staff reviewing the project's active budget

set_aside.subject: authorization for a read that creates budget state
set_aside.text: a staff read of a project's progress list, when the project has no manual budget version yet, creates that empty manual budget version
set_aside.question: Which capability must authorize this operation when the nominal progress read also performs a budget mutation: progress-read capability alone, manual-budget mutation capability as well, or a dedicated capability?
options: Require only the capability normally required to read progress
Require both progress-read and manual-budget mutation capabilities
Require a dedicated capability for the initializing read
set_aside.default_guess: Require the ordinary progress-read authorization and treat creation as an internal consequence of that read.

witness.initial: The capability sets permit a staff member to read an archived project's progress but not to maintain its manual budget.
events: The staff member requests the progress list while no manual budget version exists.
outcomes: The request succeeds and creates the empty manual budget because it is authorized as a read.
The request is refused because its hidden budget mutation requires an additional capability.

set_aside.subject: audit of implicit manual budget creation
set_aside.text: a staff read of a project's progress list, when the project has no manual budget version yet, creates that empty manual budget version
set_aside.question: Must this read-triggered creation produce an audit record, and if so, what action and affected entity does that record identify?
options: Record a budget-creation audit attributed to the staff principal
Record only the progress-read action while including the created budget as an affected entity
Treat lazy initialization as an unaudited internal storage action
set_aside.default_guess: Record an explicit budget-creation audit attributed to the staff principal.

witness.initial: An archived project has no manual budget version and its audit history is empty.
events: A staff member reads its progress list.
The read creates an empty manual budget version.
An administrator inspects the audit history.
outcomes: The history identifies the staff member and the implicit budget creation.
The budget exists but the history contains no record explaining its creation.

set_aside.subject: atomic failure of progress read with implicit creation
set_aside.text: a staff read of a project's progress list, when the project has no manual budget version yet, creates that empty manual budget version
set_aside.question: What is the observable and stored outcome if the combined progress read and manual-budget creation cannot complete atomically or fails after one part succeeds?
options: Fail the request and roll back creation
Commit the empty budget but return a failed progress read
Return the progress list even though creation failed
Retry or recover the creation before answering
set_aside.default_guess: Perform the creation and read atomically; on failure return an explicit error and leave no new budget version.

witness.initial: An archived project has no manual budget version; storage can accept the version insert but fails while completing the progress-list operation.
events: A staff member requests the progress list.
The empty manual budget insert succeeds.
The remainder of the operation fails.
outcomes: The transaction rolls back, the request fails, and no manual budget exists.
The request fails but the empty manual budget remains stored.
witness.observer: The requesting staff member and the next staff member who reads the project

set_aside.subject: concurrent initialization of the empty manual budget
set_aside.text: when the project has no manual budget version yet, creates that empty manual budget version
set_aside.question: When concurrent progress reads both observe that no manual budget version exists, must they converge on exactly one version, and what do the requests return if one loses the creation race?
options: Enforce one version and let both reads succeed against it
Enforce one version but fail one request with a conflict
Allow each read to create a separate empty manual budget version
set_aside.default_guess: Enforce exactly one version and let both reads succeed against that same version.

witness.initial: An archived project has no manual budget version.
events: Staff member A and staff member B request its progress list concurrently.
Both requests initially observe that no manual budget version exists.
outcomes: Exactly one empty manual budget version is stored and both reads use it.
Two empty manual budget versions are stored, or one staff member receives a creation conflict.
witness.observer: The two staff members and anyone later listing or activating budget versions
